transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, they brought me in because of what happened at the fair. I was giving my talk, and... I climbed right up onto the tractor. I kept jerking the controls around to show the crowd the 'new pattern.' People were yelling at me to stop and get down, but I just... I couldn't make myself stop doing it.
Can you tell me more about what you meant by the 'new pattern'?

Well, the pattern... it's the plan for how everything connects. But when I try to explain it to people, it just comes out tangled up. I start talking about the soil carbon levels, and then how the bank men are tied into it, and the satellites tracking the fields, and the seed genetics, and... county politics. It all makes sense in my head, but people just get frustrated. They tell me I'm not making sense and that I never actually get back to answering the question they asked in the first place.
Have you ever experienced a period in your life when you felt deeply depressed or down for weeks at a time?

No, I can't say that I have. I mean... sure, farming is hard work and sometimes you get worn out, but I don't get down in the dumps for weeks on end. I haven't ever really felt deeply depressed like you're talking about.
Have you ever had a time before this when you felt unusually energized or revved up for several days?

Yeah, I do get like that. Sometimes I just... I get going and I don't stop. I'll go straight from fixing fence to recalibrating the sprayer, and then I'm on the phone calling suppliers—all before breakfast. And by noon, well, I've usually started about five more jobs than any normal crew could even finish. I just get completely wound up and keep moving from one thing to the next without slowing down.
Have you ever had these ideas about the satellites and patterns during times when your energy and mood were completely normal?

Yeah, actually. There was a stretch not too long ago... maybe a few weeks where things were pretty quiet. I wasn't running around doing a million things, my energy was just regular, you know? Just doing the daily chores. But... I still heard the lines talking. And I still knew, without a doubt, that the farm data was carrying those hidden warnings. The pattern was still there, even when I wasn't all wound up.
